sql:
WITH sales AS (
  SELECT 
    c.name, 
    c.latitude, 
    c.longitude, 
    SUM(ms.total_amount) AS total_sales
  FROM master_sale ms
  JOIN customers c ON ms.customer_id = c.id
  WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ms.invoice_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ms.invoice_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')
  GROUP BY c.name, c.latitude, c.longitude
)
SELECT 
  name, 
  latitude, 
  longitude, 
  total_sales
FROM sales
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 3;
